services.desc: Description After you enjoy a famous Kona sunset from the boat and the ocean turns dark, experience close encounters with these beautiful wild animals. Snorkelers Wetsuit, mask, snorkel and fins are provided. Our in-water guides help find mantas feeding at the surface and ensure the safety and comfort of our guests. All participants must be confident enough to swim without a life jacket or flotation device and have previous snorkeling experience. Divers Mask, fins, tanks, weights, and dive lights are provided. services.name: Twilight & Manta Ray Two Tank Dive
services.desc: Description For divers only! Your first SCUBA dive takes place before the sun sets on the beautiful Kona reef at the same location where you'll participate in the night manta dive. During the surface interval, you'll enjoy the sunset from the boat while learning about manta biology and behavior. After the sun sets and the ocean turns dark, we'll get back in the water for the second dive with the mantas. The Manta Ray Night Dive is a bit like going to a rock concert or football game after dark. The area is well lit (much like being in a lighted pool or aquarium at night). Our Manta Guides and Kona's legendary resident manta ray population help make this a once in a lifetime experience.

services.name: Advanced Local Two Tank Morning Charter
services.desc: Description On Wednesday and Saturday mornings we offer our Advanced Local Morning Charter. This boat goes out for two dives at some of our more advanced local dive sites that we don't always visit on the regular Two Tank Morning Charter. We try for sites with overhead environments or swim-throughs, and sometimes drift dive. There are no students on the advanced charter, only experienced divers. For everyone's safety and enjoyment we require all participants have a minimum of 25 dives

services.name: Long Range Two Tank Morning Charter
services.desc: Description On Monday and Thursday mornings we offer our Long Range Dive Charter. This trip visits a variety of our less-frequented sites which may include drift dives, caverns, and places like the world renowned Red Hill area south of Kona or Kua Bay to the north. Check-in for this charter is the day prior at our shop. For everyone's safety and enjoyment all participants are required to have at least 25 dives minimum experience. faq.q: What is the likelihood of seeing mantas?
faq.a: What happens if I don’t see any Mantas? On average, we see manta rays about 95% of the time. They are, of course, wild creatures and no guarantees can be made for their presence. If you happen to join us on a night where we don’t see any manta rays, we are happy to offer you a 50% discount off of your next Manta Ray Night Charter with us.
